summary: Verified fixes for API-Keys page (i18n title, Active pill) and first-payment celebration suppression PASSED. However, comprehensive contrast/visibility audit reveals the bento cyber-lime reskin has SIGNIFICANT remaining low-contrast/invisible-text issues in DARK MODE on /dashboard and /developer-keys where a lime-yellow (#CCFF00) surface is used with white/gray/red-orange foreground text. Also several LIGHT mode false-positive-looking results merit inspection (see below). Auth via JWT injection, theme via localStorage 'theme-mode', celebration keys were cleared client-side only.

ui_bugs.issue: Entire main content surface is cyber-lime rgb(204,255,0); text ('API Keys' H1, 'USD API Key' card title, 'Keep your API keys secure...' body) is white rgb(255,255,255) → contrast 1.18:1. All BODY COPY & TITLES ON THE LIME SURFACE ARE INVISIBLE. 'Security Best Practices:' shown in red-orange rgb(255,107,93) on lime → 2.38:1 (poor).

'Today's revenue' KPI (bento lime accent card) uses lime bg rgb(204,255,0) with foreground text: '$87.99 USD' white on lime (1.18), 'Today's revenue' gray rgb(156,163,175) on lime (2.16), 'vs yesterday' same (2.16), and the delta chip '48.2 %' red-orange rgb(255,107,93) on lime rgb(210,225,11) (1.93). All values in this card are hard-to-read or effectively invisible — this is the exact bug the user reported.
'Overview of your cryptocurrency payment activity' page subtitle rgb(156,163,175) on lime bg rgb(204,255,0) → 2.16:1 low contrast in DARK mode.

Bento security cards + fee calculator captions render in rgb(161,161,170) on near-white rgb(248-250,...) → 2.4–2.5:1. Affected labels: 'Type II in progress', 'EU data compliant', 'Funds go direct to your wallet', 'Know-your-transaction', 'On-chain monitoring', 'Monthly processing volume', '$500', '$500K', 'Compare against', '2.9% + $0.30 per successful card charge', assumption paragraph, '0.5% flat · 133 tx', '2.9% + $0.30/tx'.
Same set of subtitles render rgb(91,91,99) on near-black rgb(11–21,...) → ~2.8–2.9:1 (still fails 4.5:1 body text minimum).

ui_bugs.component: Sidebar 'Your referral code' label + referral CTA card
ui_bugs.issue: Label rgb(10,10,10) on rgb(10,10,10) effective bg → ratio 1:1 (INVISIBLE) in LIGHT mode across every in-app page (dashboard, developer-keys, wallet, pay-links, customers, invoices, referrals, company, profile, settings). Likely the sidebar's referral promo card uses a dark backdrop image where the label text color is not adjusted.
White text rgb(255,255,255) on disabled bg rgb(176,190,197) → 1.91:1 (poor).
Badge text rgb(82,82,91) on effective bg rgb(10,10,10) → 2.56:1 (below 4.5:1 body min). These are the network chips inside wallet cards.
Numbers '1','2','3' and headings 'Share Your Code', 'They Sign Up', 'You Both Earn' rendered rgb(10,10,10) with effective bg rgb(10,10,10) → 1:1 (INVISIBLE in current mode).

design_issues.screen: Dashboard & Developer-Keys DARK mode bento cards
issues: Lime surface color success.main (#CCFF00) is being used as a full card BACKGROUND with white/gray/red text on top. Fix must set text color to a dark tone (e.g. #0A0A0A or theme.text.primary in-light) when parent bg is success.main lime. This is the same class of bug as the earlier 'green-on-green Active pill' — the reskin overrode success.main to a saturated color but left inherited light text tokens on top.

api_key_title_i18n.evidence: Document scan for /keys\.[a-z_]+/i on /developer-keys returned no match. Card title reads 'USD API Key' (from t('apiKeyTitle',{currency})).

active_pill_light_mode.evidence: Computed color=rgb(0,138,68) on bg=rgba(0,166,81,0.12) composited over white → very light green. Text with icon fully visible in screenshot. (Raw un-composited ratio 1.39 is a checker false positive; composited effective bg is nearly white so contrast is acceptable.)

dashboard_percentchip_and_tier_badge_LIG.evidence: Not flagged as invisible in light-mode screenshots; percentage chip renders with sufficient contrast. Only issue is in DARK mode when parent bento card is lime.

first_payment_celebration_suppression_fo.evidence: Cleared localStorage keys matching 'dynopay_first_payment_celebrated_*' then navigated to /transactions, waited 12s. [data-testid='first-payment-celebration-modal'] not present. document.body.innerText does NOT contain 'First payment landed'. Transactions list correctly shows 354 rows for the merchant.

action_items: CRITICAL: On /developer-keys DARK mode, the main content SURFACE is rendering as saturated lime rgb(204,255,0). Either (a) the wrapper should not use success.main as bg on this page in dark mode, or (b) all text inside that surface (H1 'API Keys', card title 'USD API Key', 'Base Currency', body copy, 'Security Best Practices' block) must switch to a dark on-lime foreground color. Confirm the styled wrappers in Components/Page/API/styled.tsx / ApiKeysPage.tsx respect dark-mode text tokens.

CRITICAL: Dashboard /dashboard DARK mode — the 'Today's revenue' KPI card uses a lime bento background. All text inside ($87.99 USD white, Today's revenue gray, vs yesterday gray, percent chip red on lime) must switch to dark text (or the card bg should not be lime in dark mode). Same class of fix as the Active-pill bento bug.

HIGH: Sidebar 'Your referral code' promo card — label text is rendered with the same color as the underlying dark background (near-invisible) on ALL in-app pages. Set an explicit light color for label inside the referral promo (or remove background-image / gradient overlay causing this).
HIGH: /referrals page — step numbers 1/2/3 and their heading text are rendered dark on dark. Adjust colors in the 'How it works' steps card.

HIGH: Landing bento 'Enterprise-grade security' cards + Fee calculator sub-labels — bump muted-copy color from rgb(161,161,170) (light) / rgb(91,91,99) (dark) to meet WCAG 4.5:1 for body text. Currently 2.4–2.9:1.
MEDIUM: /profile 'Send Verification Code' disabled-state button — white on rgb(176,190,197) is only 1.91:1. Use a darker disabled tone or higher-contrast foreground.
MEDIUM: /wallet network chips (BTC/ETH/LTC/...) — bump chip text color; currently 2.56:1.
critical_code_review_comments: The bento cyber-lime reskin is applying success.main as a BACKGROUND color in multiple large surfaces without swapping the foreground token. The 4 badges that were patched (Active pill, Percent chip, Tier badge, plus one more) are the visible tip. The root cause remains: success.main is now a lime accent used across cards, but inherited text tokens (text.primary white in dark mode, or the muted gray) are unchanged. A holistic pass across DashboardRightSection, DashboardKPICard, ApiKeysPage lime surfaces, and any 'accent' bento wrapper is needed.

In DASHBOARD DARK, my checker reported the 'Today's revenue' card bg = rgb(204,255,0) with foreground rgb(255,255,255)/rgb(156,163,175). This matches the exact user complaint verbatim ('Today's revenue / $87.99 USD / 48.2% / vs yesterday not visible') → the reported bug is only PARTIALLY fixed.
Consider defining a theme.palette.success.contrastText and always applying it to any element whose background is success.main; that would make future accent-card additions safe by construction.

The sidebar referral promo card (bottom of nav) has label text that is the same color as background across all pages — indicates a themed component that doesn't adapt its foreground to its own gradient/image background.

success_rate.frontend: Fixes verified 3/4 (title/i18n ✅, celebration ✅, light-mode pill ✅); overall contrast fix incomplete — DARK MODE dashboard + dev-keys still have invisible/low-contrast text on lime bento surfaces.

test_credentials: Used JWT for hostbay@moxx.co (user_id=1, 353+ tx) minted via /app/scripts/mint_ux_tokens.js. Theme toggled via localStorage['theme-mode']='dark'|'light'.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only test as instructed. Only client-side localStorage keys removed (dynopay_first_payment_celebrated_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: JWT injection works but the standard theme-toggle button click via Playwright fails ('not visible'); use localStorage.setItem('theme-mode','dark'|'light') + reload instead. Wait ~9-11s after navigation for Next dev route compile. To verify celebration modal, clear localStorage keys starting with 'dynopay_first_payment_celebrated_' before hitting /transactions. Contrast auditor JS with alpha-composite is at effBg() in the run script — reuse it. When checker reports bg=rgb(10,10,10) but visually the page looks fine (light mode), it means the effective composite chose an early opaque ancestor; treat those reports as inconclusive and rely on the DARK-mode lime findings + screenshots. The public landing had many muted-caption 2.4–2.9:1 contrast items in both modes.
rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: The bento re-skin changed theme.palette.success.main from a subtle light tint to a saturated lime accent (#CCFF00). It is now used as a BACKGROUND color on multiple bento surfaces (Active pill, PercentageChip, TierBadge, Dashboard 'Today's revenue' bento card, ApiKeysPage main surface in dark mode). The main-agent's previous fix patched 4 small badges by switching bg to success.light + text to success.dark, but the larger bento SURFACES on /dashboard and /developer-keys in dark mode still use success.main as bg with unadjusted white/gray/red text tokens → 1.18–2.16:1 contrast, effectively invisible/unreadable. Reproduction: login as hostbay@moxx.co (JWT), set localStorage['theme-mode']='dark', reload /dashboard or /developer-keys, observe the lime card with white/gray text. Mitigation: (a) add success.contrastText and apply to any child of a success.main surface, OR (b) explicitly override text colors on those specific bento cards to a dark tone (e.g. #0A0A0A) in the dark-mode theme.
